say:2:1230233001:0.text: I... How did you get in here? Lestial, wake up!
say:2:1230233001:0.source_cn: 我……你是从哪里来的，莱斯利，别睡了！
say:2:1230233001:0.male: I... How did you get in here? Lestial, wake up!

say:3:1230233002:1.text: Okay, I heard you! You're Sonja's guest, right?
